selected_policy: Existing commitment proposals and starts, guarded reconstruction, one fresh original audit in verified acceptance
scope: No global solver or bound calculation; unchanged physical and finer replay tolerances
notes: Case and commitment hashes identify matching inputs and candidates; no upstream case or schedule is included.
Operating profiles use two measured repetitions after two excluded 2h scheduling calls.
Extension profiles use three repetitions and warm on the synthetic turbine-table case; inspect compilation before interpreting a first call.
Baseline event times are intervals inferred from ordered stages; new event times are recorded directly.
Allocations are cumulative temporary allocations, not peak memory.
Raw recovery includes first-use compilation; its timing is not a warmed benchmark.
Two repetitions do not establish statistical significance; time-limited objectives can vary.
